newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lion Brewery cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lion Brewery cut to hold.

text.p: --Dain Bosworth Inc said Tuesday it cut its rating on Lion Brewery Inc to hold from buy, citing a lack of near-term catalysts to move the stock higher.

--The company reported slightly higher-than-expected earnings for its fiscal fourth quarter, but Dain Bosworth said it lowered its fiscal 1997 and first quarter earnings estimates. It pegs first quarter at $0.06 a share versus $0.08 last year after previously estimating $0.10. It cut its estimate for the year to $0.47 from $0.51, versus $0.47 last year.

--Dain Bosworth said it sees lower-than-expected craft beer sales in the first quarter, and it said contracted sales are running behind schedule. It said valuations of the craft beer industry have come down significantly during 1996 and cited too much competition and a possible slowing of craft beer growth.
